name: 2D Covariance Correction via Linear Regression
definition: A technique to approximate the relationship between projected 2D covariances (obtained by integrating along one axis using Simpson's rule) and actual 2D covariances (derived by removing the last row/column of the 3D covariance matrix) using a linear regression model instead of a neural network.
summary: 2D Covariance Correction via Linear Regression approximates projected 2D covariances using closed-form linear coefficients, offering a computationally efficient alternative to neural networks while maintaining reconstruction quality.
